_comment: Cursor MCP configuration for josh-business tenant. cursor-josh is read-only (memory:read only, sourceWeight=0.7). Add to Cursor settings under MCP Servers. OMNIMIND_MCP_AGENT_KEY is the omk_ key printed by keygen for THIS agent (sent as x-agent-key); OMNIMIND_API_KEY is the shared service key. OMNIMIND_MCP_USER_ID is OPTIONAL (Phase 6): the user the omnimind:// resources read as; tools always take userId explicitly. Remove the line to disable resources.
